name: get_dev_links_table
description: INSTEON ONLY. Get the physical device's own live link table (what's actually stored on the device right now) -- distinct from get_iox_links_table (NuCore's stored replica, not a live query). This drives the PLM's serial hardware directly, so it cannot run at the same time as compare_device_links/get_all_plm_links/quick_plm_sanity_check or a second call to itself -- if one of those is already in progress this returns an immediate {"error": ...} rather than waiting; just retry shortly. Params: device_id (the device's address).

device_id.description: The device's real id/address, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE.
